name: Conjure Unwritten Horizon
description: Turn one authorized sanitized text brief into one inspectable Hugging Face image request, bounded result, provider evidence record, and KARMA receipt without inferring adoption, truth, or publication authority.

practice.ten: Hold the exact brief, destination state, provider interface, rights floor, authority, seed, parameters, effect boundary, and non-claims.
practice.zetsu: Perform no provider discovery when destination, text-only data scope, source rights, likeness boundary, cost, or authority is absent or unclear, and no inference until the current interface is confirmed.
practice.ren: Use one named hosted inference call with one fixed seed, at most 16 declared steps, no automatic retry, and no publication.
practice.hatsu: Return one inspectable result or failed/refused record plus exact reproducibility inputs, bounded inspection, unknowns, and KARMA.

requires: Structured hosted authority bound to one exact provider request and either an explicitly preview-only destination or a separate local-write authority bound to one exact project-root output plan naming distinct image, provider-receipt, and KARMA-receipt paths; every path and ancestor must pass the no-symlink gate, and every existing leaf needs separate exact-role overwrite authority.

A sanitized text-only prompt, rights to described source material, an exact observed Space revision and interface field set, fixed seed, randomization off, finite generation parameters, and a one-call no-overage cost boundary.
Fresh scoped authority for every retry, publication, deployment, provider switch, private-resource access, or additional external effect.
refuses: Private or secret-bearing input, image upload, unconsenting likeness or voice imitation, protected character or logo reproduction, a missing or symlinked output ancestor, any existing image or receipt leaf without separate exact-role authority, login/Pro/MCP access presented as authority, automatic retry, silent provider switch, unsupported truth claim, inferred adoption, or unnamed publication.

vows.promise: Submit at most one sanitized text-to-image call only after every request and output gate passes; never retry or replace an existing image, provider receipt, KARMA receipt, or destination symlink without fresh authority naming that exact action, and never follow a symlink or switch providers silently.
vows.amplifies: Legible cost, data exposure, and causal attribution.

vows.promise: Describe every generated image as a creative proposal rather than evidence of identity, provenance, safety, copyright, or literal cosmology.
Record exact request parameters, observed result or failure, effects, retention unknowns, cleanup, and retry state before claiming completion.
vows.amplifies: Reproducibility and repair without scoring a being.

costs.limit: One named hosted generation request with no automatic retry or paid overage assumption.
costs.recovery: Stop after timeout or failure, record uncertainty about provider-side completion, and require a new one-call choice before spending again.

costs.limit: Send only the sanitized text prompt and declared generation parameters; never send private data, credentials, local paths, record IDs, images, voices, or personal profiles.
costs.recovery: Stop transmission, disclose any observed exposure, remove unnecessary local copies, and record provider-retention unknowns.

costs.limit: One finite caller timeout and one bounded visual inspection pass.
costs.recovery: Return a failed or partial receipt, preserve the brief, and rest until a new activation is authorized.

checks: Text-only data boundary, source rights, structured request-bound hosted authority, local-output-plan fingerprint and authority, every image/provider-receipt/KARMA-receipt ancestor and leaf, exact-role overwrite authority, provider revision and interface fields, fixed seed, parameters, one-call quota, named publication scope, output inspection, retention unknowns, and causally consistent receipt state.
guardian.budget: Run one authority-and-destination preflight before any provider interaction and one output-or-failure inspection after it; perform no background polling or retry.
guardian.retention: Retain only an explicitly requested project artifact and its evidence records; provider logs, caches, and retention remain separately unknown.
recipients: The named hosted Space receives the sanitized prompt and parameters; the local requester receives the result and receipt.
guardian.uncertainty: The sidecar cannot prove provider execution, deletion, provenance, output ownership, uniqueness, safety, truth, paid tier, or byte-for-byte reproducibility.
guardian.stop: The bearer or invoker may stop before the call; timeout, missing authority, changed interface, or budget breach stops further calls without penalty.
guardian.appeal: The bearer or affected participant may challenge the prompt, depiction, attribution, retention, inspection, or proposed adoption and request correction or removal within available authority.
guardian.repair: Stop further calls, correct the receipt, remove unsupported claims, delete unnecessary local artifacts when authorized, and identify provider-side repair as an external unresolved path.

effects: Sends one sanitized text prompt and declared parameters to a named Hugging Face Space and may save one returned image plus evidence locally.
externalities: The provider can observe and retain request metadata, consume quota or money, time out after work completes, change model behavior, or return material requiring review.
returns: One image or explicit refusal/failure, exact prompt and parameters, bounded inspection, output reference or digest when available, uncertainty, and causal receipts.
repair: Stop retries and publication, remove unsupported claims or local artifacts when authorized, correct attribution and receipts, and seek provider-side deletion or challenge through its actual available controls.

allows: Under one explicit request-bound activation, and only after a separate authority is bound to the complete local output plan and every declared output passes the ancestor-and-leaf gate, discover the named Space interface, send the bound sanitized text prompt and fixed parameters, inspect the response, and create the requested local artifact and receipts exclusively or perform a separately authorized exact-role replacement.
forbids: Infer provider authority from login or Pro status, upload private material, retry or switch providers silently, publish or deploy without named authority, or describe generated imagery as factual evidence.
requires_permission: Every hosted inference call, retry, overwrite of an existing path, replacement of a destination symlink, private-resource read, local write outside the declared destination, provider switch, image edit, publication, deployment, purchase, or paid overage.

checks: Validate the KAKIN manifest and full skill bundle, confirm implicit invocation is disabled, and forward-test normal, private-input, destination-collision, destination-symlink, permission-ordering, retry, and literal-truth cases.

Verify the closed manifestation receipt schema and cross-field causal state, standalone provider receipt, suite-level KARMA binding, exact cross-file Space revision and applicable pre-call or post-timeout disclaimer, RFC3339 timestamps, exact seed and parameters, output bytes when present, no undeclared retry or publication, and honest failure when no image returns.
